summary: Lists the changelog fragment categories that are copied into the Ansible Porting Guide: major_changes, breaking_changes, deprecated_features and removed_features.
questions: Which changelog fragment types end up in the porting guide?
Will my bugfix fragments show up in the Ansible porting guide?

answer_card.title: Fragments included in the Porting Guide
answer_card.answer_md:
These categories are added to the Ansible Porting Guide:
- `major_changes`
- `breaking_changes`
- `deprecated_features`
- `removed_features`
